articles.summary: First Financial Bankshares, Inc. (the "Company," "we," "us" or "our") (NASDAQ: FFIN) today reported earnings of $74.31 million for the third quarter of 2026 compared to earnings of $52.27 million for the same quarter a year ago and $71.89 million for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. Diluted earnings per share were $0.52 for the third quarter of 2026 compared with $0.36 for the third quarter of 2025 and $0.50 for the linked quarter. "We are pleased to report another record quarter of net income, largely driven by continued expansion of our net interest margin," said David Bailey, President and CEO. "As we enter the final quarter of the year, we remain focused on disciplined balance sheet growth and prudent risk management. We are also excited to open our new Bee Cave location later this month, establishing our first full-service branch in the Austin market and an important step in our continued expansion across Texas. articles.summary: First Financial Bank employees across the State of Texas will come together for the Bank's 11 th annual Day of Service on October 12, 2026. For the second consecutive year, the Bank will also join the Texas Bankers Association (TBA) for the Texas Banks Community Day of Service, a statewide initiative that brings Texas financial institutions together to serve and support their local communities. On Monday, October 12 th , 2026, over 1,100 First Financial employees across the State will spend their holiday volunteering with local nonprofits, schools, and service organizations. From food banks to neighborhood cleanups, the goal is simple: to make Texas stronger—together. "Community service is at the heart of who we are," said David Bailey, President and CEO of First Financial Bankshares.
